# The appointments Ọrúnmìlà made — and who is keeping them

The mistake is reading myths as entertainment. Ọrúnmìlà's cycle reads more like a charter — each story assigning a duty the modern world still pays for.

## At a Glance

- **Temple:** Ọrúnmìlà
- **Pantheon:** Yoruba
- **Domain of influence:** Wisdom, Divination, Ifá
- **Pattern seats:** 4
- **Sectors touched:** Technology & Innovation · Society & Spirit
- **Strongest seat:** AI, Data & Predictive Intelligence
- **Series:** The Resonance Files, No. 278 of 406

## The Cycle, Read Forward

### AI, Data & Predictive Intelligence — through *The Witness at the Foundation of the World*

According to Ifá tradition, Ọrúnmìlà was the only orixá present when Olódùmarè created the earth.  He observed the placement of the rivers, the rising of the mountains, and the distribution of destinies.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Ifá divination is a centuries-old decision engine with a formal knowledge base.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

### Education, Research & Knowledge — through *The Sixteen Principals*

The Ifá corpus is organised around sixteen principal odù, each with sixteen sub-odù, generating 256 basic combinations.  Each odù is a world of stories, proverbs, and medicines.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Heaven knows who will succeed; the knowledge base of Ifá.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Faith & Spiritual Organizations — through *Ọrúnmìlà and the Choice of Destiny*

In one widespread Ifá narrative, Ọrúnmìlà advises humans on how to choose their destiny (àkúnlẹ̀yàn, 'that chosen while kneeling', also àyànmọ́) before birth.  The choice is made in heaven, but once taken it binds the living.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Ifá practice thrives across West Africa and the diaspora.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. The trade thinks it is optimizing a process. It is re-enacting a charter.

### Astrology, Tarot & Esoteric Services — through *The Witness at the Foundation of the World*

According to Ifá tradition, Ọrúnmìlà was the only orixá present when Olódùmarè created the earth.  He observed the placement of the rivers, the rising of the mountains, and the distribution of destinies.

The atlas states the seat in one line: *Ifá divination as a living consultation practice.* The story above is the long version of the same sentence. Industries do not invent their archetypes; they inherit them and call them best practice.

## The Theme That Runs the Cycle

Ọrúnmìlà's mythology is textual as much as narrative: it lives in thousands of Ifá verses (òdù Ifá) that record his journeys, judgments, and interventions.

## The Method, Stated Plainly

Skeptical? Good — the system is built for you. Every seat in this file carries its why-line and its weight, the full derivation is public at the [methodology page](/patterns/methodology/), and the challenge process is part of the design. Falsifiable is not a posture here; it is the mechanism.

## For the Ones Who Work There

If you work in ai, data & predictive intelligence, education, research & knowledge, or any trade this temple holds a seat in, this is the honest version of what a placement means: your industry beside the story it has been re-telling all along — on the temple floor itself, before an audience that came specifically to read it. The [patron tier](/orunmila/patron/) and the [advertising terms](/terms/advertising/) describe the mechanics; the resonance above describes the fit.
